note: No DID. The subject is the one thing the producer must supply, and there is no useful default — an agent asked to realign 'everything' would rewrite key custody across every context the caller can reach.

A caller-supplied target name. The whole point of the task is that the recipient derives every identifier from the published document; a member for naming one would be a surface for writing chosen identifiers into a key store, which `keys/rename` deliberately is not.
An empty DID string passes `type: string` and names nothing.
dryRun as the string "true" — a truthiness bug that would turn an asked-for plan into a performed rename.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
